name: sandforge
description: Salesforce Sandbox ETL Toolkit for VSCode

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sandforge/shared build && pnpm --filter {./packages/extension} build && pnpm --filter @sandforge/webview build && pnpm run copy:webview
scripts.validate: pnpm build:shared && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm audit:disposables && pnpm build
scripts.package: pnpm build && cd packages/extension && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o ../../sandforge.vsix

pnpm.overridesComment: All entries close high-severity CVEs surfaced by `pnpm audit`. picomatch / lodash: see Round 1 commit 1b27ff9. minimatch (3 ranges, one per major): ReDoS GHSA fixed in 3.0.5 — replacement constrained to <4 so CJS-default consumers like @vscode/vsce keep working (vsce uses `__importDefault(require('minimatch'))` which only works on 3.x). vsce specifically pinned at 3.1.2 belt-and-braces. rollup ≥4.59.0: sourcemap-injection in older 4.x. flatted ≥3.4.2: prototype pollution. All devDep-only — they don't ship in the marketplace VSIX. Verified pnpm install regenerates lock cleanly + pnpm validate passes.
